race.comment: GALWAY FLYER (13) never looked likely resuming at Doomben but got going late and went better than the form guide reads. Is sure to have come on from that and will eat up the added trip. Maloney taking over is another bonus. Stablemate BLUEPINOT (1) is knocking on the door and looks the immediate danger, though he has to do it under the big weight. Doesn't need to improve much to land the winning blow. LUTON HOO (2) is a distance specialist and gets help at the weights with the 2kg claimer engaged. Will be warming nicely. HELLO DOLLY DIVA (16) has built nicely into this prep and gets the chance to keep the ball rolling, though it will be interesting to see where she lands from the wide draw.
